measurement_contract.identity_accuracy: A frozen section-aware extractive field reader answers each question from the supplied context. Exact answer equality scored, including abstention. This measures extractive task accuracy, not generative model compliance.
measurement_contract.tokens: Report UTF-8 bytes and explicitly labeled len(text)/4 estimated tokens; do not call estimates measured model tokens.
measurement_contract.consolidation: Pair detection precision/recall and explicit-answer apply/undo success; baseline no user-question detection.
measurement_contract.independent_author: NEED: independently authored Claude consolidation and identity questions; truncated user instruction cannot be reconstructed. Existing independent Claude retrieval sets are reused unchanged for recall.
